name: B10-0211/2024 (S&D) – Hong Kong, notably the cases of Jimmy Lai and the 45 activists recently convicted under the national security law
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Hong Kong, notably the cases of Jimmy Lai and the 45 activists recently convicted under the national security law
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking Hong Kong to release Jimmy Lai, the 45 activists convicted in November 2024, and all detained journalists. It wants the charges dropped and the national security law repealed, saying the law breaks international human rights rules. It also asks the European Union to consider sanctions on Hong Kong and Chinese officials and to fund legal defence for activists. This is an opinion; the Parliament cannot order these changes itself.

- Nothing changes yet; the Parliament only calls for releases, dropped charges and repeal of the law.
- It affects Jimmy Lai, the 45 convicted activists, detained journalists and Hong Kong and Chinese officials.
- Next, the resolution goes to European Union bodies and the Hong Kong and Chinese governments.
